row.team_price_text: Teams Starter Pack: $24.95/mo flat for 10 members (annual); up to 10 extra seats at $4.99/seat/mo
row.evidence: With 1Password Business, you can automate many common administrative tasks by connecting your identity provider with your 1Password account; the pricing comparison marks 'Provision users and groups' as Business-only, not Teams Starter Pack.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Prices rose since June: Teams Starter Pack $19.95 -> $24.95/mo flat for 10 members, Business $7.99 -> $8.99/u/mo (annual). team_price_per_user_mo normalised as $24.95/10; extra Teams seats are $4.99/seat/mo. SSO (OIDC Unlock with SSO), provisioning and SIEM event streaming are Business-only per the pricing comparison table (tier mapping read from table check/cross icons, which are not quotable). Provisioning is now 1Password-hosted SCIM (https://provisioning.1password.com/scim/v2, regional) for Okta, Entra ID, JumpCloud, OneLogin; Google Workspace uses a service-account directory sync instead of SCIM. Self-hosted SCIM Bridge is slated for deprecation. Deprovisioning suspends; deletion is manual on 1Password.com. Entra uses a non-gallery app in the vendor's docs. Row idp.google is directory_sync: the Google Workspace integration is a 1Password-run directory sync through a Google service account, not SCIM.

plans.name: Teams Starter Pack
plans.price_text: $24.95/mo for 10 members, billed annually ($299.40/yr); up to 10 extra seats at $4.99/seat/mo

auth.token_source: 1Password.com > Integrations > (identity provider) in User Provisioning > Set up hosted provisioning

deprovision.data_retained: Account is suspended, not deleted; vaults and the Employee vault are retained until an admin deletes the account on 1Password.com, which is only possible after deprovisioning. Devices that are offline keep cached items until they next unlock online.

roles.how: No role assignments over provisioning; groups are pushed and permissions, custom administrative roles and vault access are set on the group in 1Password.com. OneLogin roles map to 1Password groups.

limitations.text: Groups with Recover Accounts or Manage All Groups permissions are not managed by automated provisioning.
Nested groups and role assignments are not supported.
Public email domains (e.g. gmail.com) are not supported; all member domains must be on the allowed domains list.
Members cannot change their own email address once provisioning is on; reactivating a suspended user whose email was changed creates a new user.
Okta: the same group cannot be used for both app assignment and Group Push; Okta lifecycle management is required.

Google Workspace is not SCIM: it uses a Google service account and a Cloud Run job in the customer's Google Cloud project; provisioning runs hourly, deprovisioning immediately; users outside synced groups are suspended.
Hosted provisioning supports only Entra ID, Google Workspace, JumpCloud, Okta and OneLogin; migrating from a self-hosted SCIM Bridge is one-way, and SCIM Bridge will be deprecated.
The SCIM endpoint list is documented only for the self-hosted SCIM Bridge; it is not documented separately for hosted provisioning.

rate_limits.text: Users API: 100 requests/minute and 6000/hour. Events API: 600 requests/minute and 30,000/hour.

limitations.text: Users API is a public preview; functionality may change or be removed.
Users API integrations are not supported on accounts that use automated provisioning.
Users API only lists, gets, suspends and reactivates users; no create, update, delete or group management. Full user and group management is only through 1Password CLI.
Events API returns only the last 120 days of data.
The SCIM API in the 1password.dev API reference (/api/scim/v2/Users) is for 1Password SaaS Manager users, not the password manager.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace directory sync via a Google service account (non-SCIM); 1Password CLI user provisioning (op user provision); invites by email, sign-up link or the 1Password Slack app.
